passages.statement: The chord stone erases the last hour from the memory of whoever carries it.
The chord stone is kept in a lead-lined box in the Old Archive.
Walking from the Lighthouse to the Harbor takes about forty minutes.
Leya Venn is a cartographer's apprentice.
Arin Venn is the keeper of the Solen Lighthouse.
Leya and Arin are biological siblings; Arin is four years older.
Mara and Arin were engaged until Arin broke it off at 19:00 on Day 1.
Mara Holt is a boat runner who trades at the Salt Market.
Teodor Brask is the last archivist of the Old Archive.
Leya is at the Harbor at 08:00 on Day 1.
Mara is at the Harbor at 12:30 on Day 2.
Leya is in the Old Archive from 13:00 to 14:00 on Day 1.
Leya holds the chord stone with her bare hands for about an hour on Day 1.
Arin is crossing the causeway at 22:00 on Day 1.
Arin stays in the Lighthouse gallery from 21:30 to 22:30 on Day 1.
Arin carries the chord stone in a leather pouch overnight on Day 2.
Arin still remembers the whole night walk at dawn on Day 3.
Mara is at the Salt Market around midday on Day 2.
Leya has no memory of 13:00–14:00 on Day 1, attributed to the chord stone.
Arin is Mara's fiancé at 10:00 on Day 3.
Arin is at the Lighthouse at 10:00 on Day 3.
Teodor briefly presses the chord stone to Arin's hand so he forgets the night.
Arin rings the harbor bell at the Harbor at 10:15 on Day 3.
